title: WCAG 2.1 AA contrast audit helpers (token resolver, pair enumerator, luminance math)
description: Baz 2026-10-04 (w-2026-10-04-dave-001): the audit helper for US-207. `buildTokenMap(css, theme)` resolves the `--sv-*` custom-property blocks (light `:root` and dark `:root[data-theme="dark"]`), chasing `var(--x)` aliases. `extractRules(css)` is a brace-balanced walker that handles `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` scope. `resolveColour(value, tokens)` reduces a CSS colour expression to `{r,g,b,a}` and returns null for gradients/images. `composite()` composites a semi-transparent fg over a bg. `luminance()` + `contrastRatio()` implement the WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance ratio. `stateOf(selector)` tags state variants (default, hover, focus, focus-visible, active, aria-pressed, aria-selected, is-active, disabled). `thresholdFor(selector, decls)` picks 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large text or non-text UI boundaries. `enumeratePairs(css)` returns per-theme `PairRecord[]` with `{selector,state,theme,fg,bg,ratio,threshold,kind,pass,approximate,note}` so the test's failure line names selector, state, theme, fg, bg, ratio and threshold.
